The role entails

  • Execute outbound sales & marketing campaigns
  • Research information about prospective customers and market trends
  • Generate high-quality leads for Senior Sellers to fuel a multi-million dollar pipeline
  • Own and close SMB opportunities within your designated territory
  • Collaborate across multiple teams and senior stakeholders to drive results
  • Help define the processes and policies for the team
  • Travel to events and conferences worldwide, presenting on booths and driving face-to-face marketing and sales opportunities

  • Demonstrated success in SDR or outbound sales, with a track record of exceeding annual quotas and consistently driving qualified pipeline growth

  • Creative problem solving and cross team collaboration

  • Persistence & perseverance
  • Growth mindset - people from our team develop into all departments within the sales organization (Channel, IoT, Enterprise Sales, etc)
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

  8. Aplicar método para desenvolvimento contínuo dos produtos, contemplando análises, reports e plano de ação para evolução da solução, com o objetivo de garantir a melhor experiência para o usuário.

Requisitos

Habilidades e Qualificações Necessárias:

  1. Proficiência em ferramentas de design como Figma e pacote Adobe para prototipação navegável em alta fidelidade e criação de artefatos diversos.

  6. Portfólio robusto demonstrando trabalhos de design de produto de alta qualidade.
  7. Experiência com metodologias de design centrado no usuário.
  8. Experiência prática utilizando design system.
  9. Habilidade para fazer a adequada documentação dos entregáveis.
  10. Excelente comunicação e habilidades de colaboração.
  11. Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e capacidade de pensar estrategicamente.
  12. Orientação para detalhes com um olhar aguçado para estética e detalhes visuais.
  13. Fortes habilidades interpessoais e capacidade de trabalhar bem em equipe.
  14. Adaptabilidade e abertura para feedback.
  15. Atitude proativa e capacidade de tomar iniciativa.
  16. Habilidade de influência para contribuir com a cultura de design.

Educação e Experiência:

  1. Graduação em Design, Design de Interação ou área relacionada.

  5. Promover e participar da integração da equipe multiprofissional, dos treinamentos e eventos pertinentes, procurando garantir uma assistência integral ao cliente e familiares.

  7.   8. Garantir as ações de preventiva e corretiva dos equipamentos da unidade, preservando o funcionamento adequado conforme políticas institucionais.

  13. Promover e difundir medidas de prevenção de riscos e agravos por meio da educação paciente e familiares, objetivando melhorar a qualidade de vida do paciente.

Sobre a Associação Congregação de Santa Catarina (ACSC)

Há 120 anos no Brasil, a Associação Congregação de Santa Catarina (ACSC) é responsável pela administração de 19 entidades com atuação social, em saúde e educação, que formam a Rede Santa Catarina. Com um modelo de gestão em que o superávit gerado é aplicado em nossas obras a fim de executar dignamente nossas atividades, a instituição acolhe e cuida do ser humano em todo o ciclo da vida. Ao todo são cerca de 10,5 mil colaboradores distribuídos em diversas instituições de saúde, mantendo inúmeros estabelecimentos de ensino e acolhendo crianças, adultos e idosos em espaços assistenciais, com atendimento humanizado e serviços de qualidade para milhares de pessoas em seis Estados brasileiros (Espírito Santo, Goiás, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, Santa Catarina e São Paulo).

MISSÃO

Acolher e cuidar do ser humano durante todo o ciclo da vida.

VISÃO

Ser referência de entidade filantrópica reconhecida pela sociedade, demonstrando amor às pessoas por meio de nossos atos.

VALORES

Preservação da vida, Humanização, Dignidade, Transparência e Sustentabilidade.

Conheça os requisitos antes de se candidatar:

  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura de servidores Windows e Linux;

  • Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal;
  • Habilidade em automação de pipeline CI/CD;
  • Domínio em ferramentas SAST e DAST;
  • Conhecimento de desenvolvimento seguro para analisar e corrigir vulnerabilidade;
  • Conhecimento em containers e virtualização;
  • Experiencia em modelagem de ameaças;
  • Compreensão dos conceitos de infraestrutura com código (IaC);
  • Conhecimento de metodologia ágeis, DevSecOps, CSSLP (Certified Security Software Lifecycle Professional) e CDSP (Certified DevOps Security Professional)
  • Formação em áreas de tecnologia da informação ou correlatas (eg. Engenharia de Computação, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Processamento de Dados, Segurança da Informação, Redes, etc);
  • Desejável pós-graduação em áreas de tecnologia ou segurança da informação;
  • Desejável certificações em segurança da informação tais como OSCP, OSCE, OSWE, SANS GIAC, CEH, DCPT, CompTIA, CSSLP (Certified Security Software Lifecycle Professional), CDSP (Certified DevOps Security Professional) entre outras.

  • Atualizar sistematicamente os registros de ações tomadas e resultados obtidos.

3 - Monitoramento de Indicadores e Resultados:

  • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho, como dias médios de recebimento (DSO) e índice de inadimplência;
  • Emitir relatórios periódicos de títulos vencidos, status de cobrança e evolução dos recebimentos.

4 - Conformidade e Documentação:

  • Manter controle rigoroso sobre a documentação de cobrança, acordos e comprovantes;
  • Seguir os Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (POP) da área financeira, garantindo a conformidade e a rastreabilidade das ações.

5 - Comunicação e Integração com Outras Áreas:

  • Colaborar com áreas comerciais e administrativas para alinhamento de estratégias de cobrança;
  • Informar gestores sobre clientes em situação de risco e propor ações corretivas.
Requisitos:
  • Formação Acadêmica: Ensino médio completo (desejável curso técnico ou superior em Administração, Contabilidade, Finanças ou áreas afins);
  • Experiência: Experiência prévia com cobrança, contas a receber ou área financeira;
  • Competências Técnicas: Conhecimento em sistemas de gestão financeira, pacote Office, comunicação clara e negociação;
  • Perfil Comportamental: Organização, persistência, foco em resultado, ética e bom relacionamento interpessoal.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Customer Success - Team Manager.
To support Canonical's growth, we are expanding our CSM team globally and recruiting leaders to help our team of Customer Success Managers across regions. We consider our Customer Success operations an exceptional tool to sustain revenue retention and growth, placing excellence in delivering outstanding customer services in the new technologies sector. As such, we are looking for exceptional candidates with proven track records in Customer Success and an obvious passion for new technologies. Ideally, you have been a Customer Success Manager at one point in your career and naturally evolved to a leading position.
You will enjoy this role if you are organised, persistent, analytical, diplomatic, a listener, hard-working, and determined to grow your skills and teams. As a lead, you are to provide mentoring, coaching in post-sales account management and feedback to team members. You play a crucial role in proactively identifying areas of improvement and implementing process change, driving high-performing teams. You are comfortable dealing with ambiguity and quickly adapt to changes. You seek collaboration with other teams to enhance the overall customer experience. Your key responsibility is to analyze regional performance metrics, identify trends and opportunities for improvement, and implement changes to increase efficiency and achieve business objectives. You will work hand-in-hand with the Head of Customer Success.
CSMs engage a diverse customer base and follow diverse CSM motions to provide the appropriate level of focus for every customer. The right candidate would adapt to this diversity and bring broad experience to the team.
Location: This is a globally remote role
The role entails:

  • Strategic planning and analysis: preparing communication plans, Team Meetings, and other messages shared in broader management forums, setting yourself and your team up for success. Regularly reviewing key performance indicators and metrics is your baseline. You develop strategies to enhance customer engagement, improve retention rates, drive upsells or cross-sells where appropriate, and ultimately increase customer success.
  • Customer interactions and support to your team: you resolve escalated customer issues requiring expertise or intervention. You work closely with your team members to ensure timely resolution.
  • Team management: you are passionate about guiding and supporting your team members, helping them navigate complex customer situations, improve their skills, and achieve their goals. You are ready for regular performance reviews with team members. While your help in identifying areas for improvement is key, you are asked to celebrate excellence, recognise your team's achievements, and set goals for individual growth within the team.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: collaboration with other departments, such as Sales, Marketing, Product development, and Support, is essential. This ensures alignment on customer needs, feedback sharing, and coordinated efforts to drive customer success. You establish trustworthy channels of communication across the board.
  • Documentation and reporting: you are allowed to be creative! While building content with your team and your manager, you also ensure the changes are well documented, instilling quality and attention to detail in all you do.
What we are looking for in you
  • Excellent academic results at school and university
  • Bachelor's or equivalent degree in Business, Communication or STEM
  • Knowledge and passion for Customer Success, revenue management and technology, experience in SaaS or software industries
  • Track record of bringing exceptional Customer Success experience results
  • Commitment to continuous learning and improvement - curious, flexible, scientific
  • Creative problem-solving and cross-team collaboration
  • Experience growing and developing a CSM team
  • Hands-on approach to using data to drive team activities and continuous improvement
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
Nice-to-have skills
  • We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, or Italian, alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us!
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Senior Compliance Advisory Analyst
description:
Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Ifood, Uber, Spotify, and Adidas - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

Senior Compliance Advisory Analyst

Our fast-paced Compliance Advisory team is looking for a Senior Compliance Advisory Analyst who brings a strong second line compliance mindset and solution-oriented approach to evaluating complex business opportunities in the merchant/platform acquiring and banking spaces. A successful candidate excels at deconstructing complex compliance challenges into manageable components, effectively communicating with internal and external stakeholders, managing cross-team projects, and identifying risk mitigations to support Adyen’s growth. The Senior Compliance Advisory Officer will leverage their knowledge of key financial services risks (regulatory, licensing, scheme, KYC, AML, consumer protection) to review new and existing merchant opportunities, as well as support Adyen’s expansion into new sub-verticals. Our team wears many hats – partnering with commercial teams to unlock new sub-verticals across Latin America and other regions, advising the business and first line teams on compliance risks, and reviewing and approving escalated merchant/platform onboarding cases. No two days are alike.

We are looking for a proactive, hands-on individual who exercises sound judgment, takes ownership of projects, and thrives in a dynamic environment. The ideal candidate is structured, efficient and able to work on multiple complex queries simultaneously.

What you’ll do

  • Work closely with commercial teams to unlock new business verticals in a controlled and compliant manner, developing the necessary compliance frameworks to support sustainable growth.
  • Act as a key point of contact for escalated merchant/platform compliance matters, ensuring timely and effective resolution.
  • Engage with internal stakeholders—including legal, regulatory, scheme, AML and KYC teams—to provide clarity and direction on complex compliance issues.
  • Assess and analyze compliance risks related to AML/CFT, card scheme rules, Pix rules, and regulatory obligations, identifying potential threats and recommending mitigating actions.
  • Understand the organization’s risk appetite regarding compliance risks and apply a risk-based approach to decision-making, drafting and implementing control frameworks.
  • Develop and implement structured processes and tooling to enhance efficiency in handling compliance escalations.
  • Identify opportunities for automation and process improvements to optimize compliance workflows.
  • Support the development of frameworks and procedures to enhance the Compliance team’s response strategy.
  • Collaborate with global team members across time zones, ensuring seamless communication and execution of compliance initiatives.

Who you are

  • You have 8 - 12 years experience in a compliance, regulatory, or risk function within a financial institution, regulatory body, law firm, payments company, audit firm, or financial crime investigation unit.
  • You have business-level proficiency in Portuguese and English; Spanish language skills are an added bonus.
  • You have availability to work 3 days on site in our office, based in Morumbi/São Paulo.
  • You have robust knowledge of regulatory and licensing regimes governing payment/e-money institutions.
  • You have a strong understanding of risks in the payments and banking sector and how they materialize.
  • You possess a thorough understanding of AML/CFT and/or consumer compliance risks and how to manage them effectively.
  • You can break down complex compliance issues into clear, concise components and communicate them effectively to various stakeholders.
  • You demonstrate a critical approach, use sound judgment, and make informed decisions quickly.
  • You are proactive, take ownership of projects, and work independently.
  • You thrive in fast-paced environments, managing multiple intricate queries simultaneously.
  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills—clear, direct, and concise.
  • You are adept at stakeholder management and balancing multiple priorities effectively.
  • You are flexible in working with global colleagues across different time zones.
  • You foster teamwork and collaboration while also challenging ideas constructively.

Our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion Commitments

Our unobvious approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical goals are unique, we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. So no matter where you’re from, who you love, or what you believe in, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.

Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Do you recognise yourself in this statement? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application.

What is next?

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 7 business days. Our interview process tends to take between 3 or 4 weeks to complete. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

The way we work is guided by the eight principles of the Adyen Formula. Learn more here.

To build the world's most customer-focused financial technology platform, we need as many different perspectives as possible. We’re looking for people from all sorts of backgrounds to contribute.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Customer Success - Team Manager.
To support Canonical's growth, we are expanding our CSM team globally and recruiting leaders to help our team of Customer Success Managers across regions. We consider our Customer Success operations an exceptional tool to sustain revenue retention and growth, placing excellence in delivering outstanding customer services in the new technologies sector. As such, we are looking for exceptional candidates with proven track records in Customer Success and an obvious passion for new technologies. Ideally, you have been a Customer Success Manager at one point in your career and naturally evolved to a leading position.
You will enjoy this role if you are organised, persistent, analytical, diplomatic, a listener, hard-working, and determined to grow your skills and teams. As a lead, you are to provide mentoring, coaching in post-sales account management and feedback to team members. You play a crucial role in proactively identifying areas of improvement and implementing process change, driving high-performing teams. You are comfortable dealing with ambiguity and quickly adapt to changes. You seek collaboration with other teams to enhance the overall customer experience. Your key responsibility is to analyze regional performance metrics, identify trends and opportunities for improvement, and implement changes to increase efficiency and achieve business objectives. You will work hand-in-hand with the Head of Customer Success.
CSMs engage a diverse customer base and follow diverse CSM motions to provide the appropriate level of focus for every customer. The right candidate would adapt to this diversity and bring broad experience to the team.
Location: This is a globally remote role
The role entails:

  • Strategic planning and analysis: preparing communication plans, Team Meetings, and other messages shared in broader management forums, setting yourself and your team up for success. Regularly reviewing key performance indicators and metrics is your baseline. You develop strategies to enhance customer engagement, improve retention rates, drive upsells or cross-sells where appropriate, and ultimately increase customer success.
  • Customer interactions and support to your team: you resolve escalated customer issues requiring expertise or intervention. You work closely with your team members to ensure timely resolution.
  • Team management: you are passionate about guiding and supporting your team members, helping them navigate complex customer situations, improve their skills, and achieve their goals. You are ready for regular performance reviews with team members. While your help in identifying areas for improvement is key, you are asked to celebrate excellence, recognise your team's achievements, and set goals for individual growth within the team.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: collaboration with other departments, such as Sales, Marketing, Product development, and Support, is essential. This ensures alignment on customer needs, feedback sharing, and coordinated efforts to drive customer success. You establish trustworthy channels of communication across the board.
  • Documentation and reporting: you are allowed to be creative! While building content with your team and your manager, you also ensure the changes are well documented, instilling quality and attention to detail in all you do.

All about the role:

For more than one hundred years now, the Electrolux Group has been working towards shaping living for the better, developing and manufacturing products to answer people's needs regarding taste, care, and wellbeing. The Electrolux Tech teams have the mission of creating solutions optimized for the future of the business, delivering outstanding experiences through the use of traditional and new technologies. It's their proactive work that allows the Electrolux Group to keep going on the forefront of innovation within the consumer journey.

What you'll do:

Are you a network and infrastructure expert ready to support and shape connectivity? We’re building a Talent Pool of professionals with deep technical knowledge in WAN, LAN, WLAN, and enterprise infrastructure, who are passionate about delivering robust, scalable, and secure network solutions.

By joining our talent community, you’ll be considered for future opportunities where you can:

- Act as a technical authority in network architecture and infrastructure

- Support global projects and ensure alignment with enterprise standards

- Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to deliver high-performance infrastructure

- Create and maintain technical documentation, guidelines, and best practices

- Define and monitor SLAs, KPIs, and service delivery metrics

- Have strong experience in enterprise networking (WAN, LAN, WLAN)

- Are familiar with network architecture, design, and implementation

- Can work across global teams and manage vendor relationships

- Are proactive, analytical, and solution-oriented

You can be based at the Curitiba administrative office. Or you can also be based at the São Paulo office, the center of Electrolux Sales and Marketing operations in Brazil and the workplace of collaborators who are driven by the creation of value along the steps of the Consumer Journey.

In order to create a culture of inclusion and care for everyone's wellbeing, we offer the following benefits:

- Flexible work hours/hybrid work environment;

- Discounts on our award-winning Electrolux products and services;

As part of the Electrolux Group, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you.

description:

Join to apply for the Customer Success - Team Manager role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Customer Success - Team Manager.
To support Canonical's growth, we are expanding our CSM team globally and recruiting leaders to help our team of Customer Success Managers across regions. We consider our Customer Success operations an exceptional tool to sustain revenue retention and growth, placing excellence in delivering outstanding customer services in the new technologies sector. As such, we are looking for exceptional candidates with proven track records in Customer Success and an obvious passion for new technologies. Ideally, you have been a Customer Success Manager at one point in your career and naturally evolved to a leading position.
You will enjoy this role if you are organised, persistent, analytical, diplomatic, a listener, hard-working, and determined to grow your skills and teams. As a lead, you are to provide mentoring, coaching in post-sales account management and feedback to team members. You play a crucial role in proactively identifying areas of improvement and implementing process change, driving high-performing teams. You are comfortable dealing with ambiguity and quickly adapt to changes. You seek collaboration with other teams to enhance the overall customer experience. Your key responsibility is to analyze regional performance metrics, identify trends and opportunities for improvement, and implement changes to increase efficiency and achieve business objectives. You will work hand-in-hand with the Head of Customer Success.
CSMs engage a diverse customer base and follow diverse CSM motions to provide the appropriate level of focus for every customer. The right candidate would adapt to this diversity and bring broad experience to the team.
Location: This is a globally remote role
The role entails:

  • Strategic planning and analysis: preparing communication plans, Team Meetings, and other messages shared in broader management forums, setting yourself and your team up for success. Regularly reviewing key performance indicators and metrics is your baseline. You develop strategies to enhance customer engagement, improve retention rates, drive upsells or cross-sells where appropriate, and ultimately increase customer success.
  • Customer interactions and support to your team: you resolve escalated customer issues requiring expertise or intervention. You work closely with your team members to ensure timely resolution.
  • Team management: you are passionate about guiding and supporting your team members, helping them navigate complex customer situations, improve their skills, and achieve their goals. You are ready for regular performance reviews with team members. While your help in identifying areas for improvement is key, you are asked to celebrate excellence, recognise your team's achievements, and set goals for individual growth within the team.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: collaboration with other departments, such as Sales, Marketing, Product development, and Support, is essential. This ensures alignment on customer needs, feedback sharing, and coordinated efforts to drive customer success. You establish trustworthy channels of communication across the board.
  • Documentation and reporting: you are allowed to be creative! While building content with your team and your manager, you also ensure the changes are well documented, instilling quality and attention to detail in all you do.
What we are looking for in you
  • Excellent academic results at school and university
  • Bachelor's or equivalent degree in Business, Communication or STEM
  • Knowledge and passion for Customer Success, revenue management and technology, experience in SaaS or software industries
  • Track record of bringing exceptional Customer Success experience results
  • Commitment to continuous learning and improvement - curious, flexible, scientific
  • Creative problem-solving and cross-team collaboration
  • Experience growing and developing a CSM team
  • Hands-on approach to using data to drive team activities and continuous improvement
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
Nice-to-have skills
  • We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, or Italian, alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us!
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Developer Relations Engineer
description:
Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Developer Relations Engineer role at Canonical

16 hours ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Developer Relations Engineer role at Canonical

As the publisher of Ubuntu we serve millions of developers, building for the cloud, IoT and data science. We aim to make open source easier and more reliable for innovators and enterprises.
We have created a new Developer Relations team to engage directly with open source communities and developer-centric organisations. We hope both to communicate our vision and products for better open source development experiences, and also to have a better feedback loop from those audiences to shape our offerings and priorities.
A Developer Relations Engineer is a technical expert, strategist and communicator with deep empathy for developers. This discipline combines practical engineering skills with firm diplomacy across organisational boundaries, in both directions. Like our audience, a Developer Relations Engineer is never satisfied with the status quo, and is driven by an insatiable curiosity to find better ways to get things done. They are problem-solvers and inventors, who understand people's needs and love the way that tools can be adapted to meet them. They stay current with tech trends and provide insights and guidance while fostering innovation.
To improve your chances of success in this application, read our advice on how to get a job at Canonical.
Location : we are building our initial DevRel team in Europe, Middle East, African and American time zones
What your day will look like
In a typical day, a developer relations engineer might:

  • take part in team product meetings, at levels from strategy to day-by-day development progress, contributing insight and expertise
  • maintain conversations with developer community members wherever they may be found - IRC, social media, product forums, meet-ups and more
  • work with colleagues in other teams in the company, as part of efforts to help establish commonality and consistent approaches
  • help solve specific technical problems that users or colleagues have identified
  • contribute to technical documentation to ensure that developer users' needs are met there
  • work on technical articles, presentations or workshops
  • identify new opportunities and directions for improvement in the developer experience we provide
  • present at conferences, meetups or technical events
What we are looking for in you
A strong candidate
  • is a programmer or developer with a demonstrable passion for and engagement in open-source software
  • has worked with real-world challenges developing and deploying software using Linux
  • has practical hands-on experience of Linux software packaging (including Snaps, debs, charms, rocks, PIP, containers)
  • understands current software packing issues and trends in the Linux ecosystem
  • has been a contributor to open-source communities, software and documentation
  • is an engaging, vivacious speaker and presenter
  • can work effectively, tactfully, empathetically and confidently in contexts where different parties have different perspectives, needs and understanding
  • builds trust, relationships and confidence
  • is willing to travel globally twice a year for company events, as well as to upstream and partner events
Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring
  • previous experience in a developer advocacy or community role
  • in-depth familiarity with Ubuntu and the Canonical ecosystem of products
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Sales at TRACTIAN

The Sales team is the driving factor behind revenue at Tractian. We focus on generating new opportunities, acquiring new customers, and building even stronger relationships with our current accounts. Our Enterprise customers are comprised of Fortune 500 companies, such as Hyundai, Bosch, Unilever, P&G, PepsiCo, and others. We make sure that top performers are recognized and over-beating quota.

As an Energy Implementation Specialist at Tractian, your main objective will be to drive the sales of our innovative energy monitoring solutions. You will leverage your expertise in energy management, water and electrical consumption, thermal systems, and industrial process automation to engage with clients and demonstrate the capabilities of Energy Trac. You will conduct energy consumption analyses, identify cost reduction and savings opportunities, and correlate various production variables to optimize energy usage in industrial settings. Your ability to read, understand, and explain single-line diagrams and industrial electrical systems fluently is essential.

Responsibilities

  • Understanding and managing energy systems, water consumption, electrical energy consumption, thermal systems, and industrial process automation;
  • Conduct energy consumption analyses, identify cost reduction and savings opportunities, make technical correlations between different production variables, aiming to understand, explain, and optimize energy use in industries;
  • Read, understand, and explain single-line diagrams and industrial electrical systems fluently;
  • Capable of handling different industrial verticals, responsible for the client portfolio, and providing proactive support to the Sales Engineer, Customer Success, and Sales teams;
  • Prospect, understand, analyze, and bring opportunities for feature and product development to internal TRACTIAN teams;
  • Lead technical discussions with clients about product updates and future needs;
  • Maintain excellent relationships with clients (internal and external), seeking opportunities for commercial expansion and long-term relationships;
  • Knowledgeable about machinery and industrial processes;
  • Utilize the TRACTIAN platform and solutions for client demonstrations, being able to conduct brief training sessions and usage exemplifications of the solution;
  • Prepare, commission, and be responsible for clients' energy diagnostics;
  • Create energy performance indicators (EPIs) and production/energy KPIs;
  • Monitor and analyze product performance in client environments, generating insights and opportunities for the client and the TRACTIAN Sales team;
  • Available for travel and client visits and participation in trade shows and events;
  • Create, develop, and update technical documents;
  • Provide specific training for internal and external clients;
  • Quantify and verify (M&V) electrical variables, providing valuable insights for product development and client relations;
  • Provide technical support to the TRACTIAN Sales and Sales Engineering teams, creating customized solutions for clients' diverse needs;
  • Document, update, and showcase best practices and success cases regarding energy efficiency;
  • Familiar with and apply ISO 27001 and ISO 50001 guidelines, capable of creating correlations between standard topics and clients' industrial applications, as well as energy audit systems;
  • Calculate Return on Investment (ROI) and Payback Period (PPB);
  • Generate reports, make presentations with this focus to support the client in substantiating multi-product commercial expansions;
  • Knowledgeable about Industrial Automation as well as communication protocols used in the industry such as Modbus RTU, Ethernet, Profibus, Modbus TCP, among others;
  • Knowledge in demand analysis, load factor, power factor, and harmonics of consumer units.

title: Customer Success - Team Manager
description:
Join to apply for the Customer Success - Team Manager role at Canonical

Join to apply for the Customer Success - Team Manager role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Customer Success - Team Manager.
To support Canonical's growth, we are expanding our CSM team globally and recruiting leaders to help our team of Customer Success Managers across regions. We consider our Customer Success operations an exceptional tool to sustain revenue retention and growth, placing excellence in delivering outstanding customer services in the new technologies sector. As such, we are looking for exceptional candidates with proven track records in Customer Success and an obvious passion for new technologies. Ideally, you have been a Customer Success Manager at one point in your career and naturally evolved to a leading position.
You will enjoy this role if you are organised, persistent, analytical, diplomatic, a listener, hard-working, and determined to grow your skills and teams. As a lead, you are to provide mentoring, coaching in post-sales account management and feedback to team members. You play a crucial role in proactively identifying areas of improvement and implementing process change, driving high-performing teams. You are comfortable dealing with ambiguity and quickly adapt to changes. You seek collaboration with other teams to enhance the overall customer experience. Your key responsibility is to analyze regional performance metrics, identify trends and opportunities for improvement, and implement changes to increase efficiency and achieve business objectives. You will work hand-in-hand with the Head of Customer Success.
CSMs engage a diverse customer base and follow diverse CSM motions to provide the appropriate level of focus for every customer. The right candidate would adapt to this diversity and bring broad experience to the team.
Location: This is a globally remote role
The role entails:

  • Strategic planning and analysis: preparing communication plans, Team Meetings, and other messages shared in broader management forums, setting yourself and your team up for success. Regularly reviewing key performance indicators and metrics is your baseline. You develop strategies to enhance customer engagement, improve retention rates, drive upsells or cross-sells where appropriate, and ultimately increase customer success.
  • Customer interactions and support to your team: you resolve escalated customer issues requiring expertise or intervention. You work closely with your team members to ensure timely resolution.
  • Team management: you are passionate about guiding and supporting your team members, helping them navigate complex customer situations, improve their skills, and achieve their goals. You are ready for regular performance reviews with team members. While your help in identifying areas for improvement is key, you are asked to celebrate excellence, recognise your team's achievements, and set goals for individual growth within the team.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: collaboration with other departments, such as Sales, Marketing, Product development, and Support, is essential. This ensures alignment on customer needs, feedback sharing, and coordinated efforts to drive customer success. You establish trustworthy channels of communication across the board.
  • Documentation and reporting: you are allowed to be creative! While building content with your team and your manager, you also ensure the changes are well documented, instilling quality and attention to detail in all you do.
What we are looking for in you
  • Excellent academic results at school and university
  • Bachelor's or equivalent degree in Business, Communication or STEM
  • Knowledge and passion for Customer Success, revenue management and technology, experience in SaaS or software industries
  • Track record of bringing exceptional Customer Success experience results
  • Commitment to continuous learning and improvement - curious, flexible, scientific
  • Creative problem-solving and cross-team collaboration
  • Experience growing and developing a CSM team
  • Hands-on approach to using data to drive team activities and continuous improvement
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
Nice-to-have skills
  • We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, or Italian, alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us!
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Funk se torna gênero oficial no Beatport
description:
Funk se torna gênero oficial no Beatport

A partir de sexta-feira, 25 de abril, o funk brasileiro foi oficialmente reconhecido como um gênero próprio na maior plataforma de venda e distribuição musical para DJs e música eletrônica, o Beatport . Essa conquista marca um passo importante na internacionalização do ritmo, que nasceu nas periferias do Brasil. A ONErpm , grupo musical presente em 43 localidades globais, com seu maior escritório no Brasil, foi uma parceira fundamental nesse processo.

“Estou muito empolgado com o lançamento deste gênero e com a oportunidade de apoiar a comunidade vibrante do Funk no Brasil. Este movimento cultural prospera há décadas, e agora é hora de amplificá-lo globalmente, destacando todo seu talento e herança,” afirma Raphael Pujol, VP de Curadoria Global do Beatport.

Com o apoio da ONErpm Brasil, o funk deixa de ser uma subcategoria no Beatport para ganhar seu espaço próprio, incluindo charts, playlists exclusivas e maior visibilidade para DJs, artistas, produtores e selos ao redor do mundo. Essa mudança é um marco para o funk, que antes enfrentava dificuldades para ser descoberto e valorizado em plataformas fora do universo da música eletrônica.

“Celebramos a criação do gênero ‘funk brasileiro’ no Beatport. Este reconhecimento reforça o que a ONErpm acredita há mais de uma década. Desde 2012, somos a casa dos maiores produtores, empresários e DJs de funk do Brasil, ajudando a revelar talentos e levar essa cultura ao cenário global. Ver o funk ocupando seu espaço nas grandes plataformas é um marco histórico. Estamos prontos para continuar liderando essa jornada ao lado do Beatport,” comenta Arthur Fitzgibbon, Presidente da ONErpm Brasil.

O funk brasileiro agora está no radar mundial, e o reconhecimento do Beatport reforça sua crescente visibilidade. Essa oficialização confirma que o funk deixou de ser um fenômeno regional para se tornar uma parte essencial da música contemporânea global. Ele aparece em sets de DJs internacionais, inspira lançamentos globais e ocupa espaço em playlists ao redor do mundo. Assim, o gênero, brasileiro por essência, agora ocupa lugar de destaque na cena eletrônica mundial, simbolizando potência e representatividade.

“Ao longo dos anos, vi artistas incorporando o Funk em seus sets, tanto no Brasil quanto em festivais internacionais. Agora, é hora de oficializar isso. O Beatport é um parceiro da ONErpm, e é gratificante ver toda essa repercussão e contribuir para a internacionalização da música brasileira. A música eletrônica é um fenômeno global, sem fronteiras — e nossa cultura merece estar nesse cenário,” afirma Antônio Neto, Project Manager de Dança / Eletrônica da ONErpm.

title: Analista de Logistica JR.
description:
O profissional será responsável pelas seguintes atividades:

  1. Programação Estratégica da Frota: Planejar e otimizar a alocação de veículos, considerando demandas, rotas e recursos disponíveis, visando a máxima eficiência operacional.
  2. Garantia da Padronização de Processos: Implementar e monitorar a aderência a procedimentos operacionais padrão na área de programação de frota, assegurando a consistência e qualidade das atividades.
  3. Interface entre Áreas Operacionais: Atuar como ponto focal de comunicação entre as áreas de manutenção, frota e logística, assegurando o alinhamento das informações e a resolução eficiente de questões operacionais.
  4. Gestão do Relacionamento com a Área Comercial: Colaborar com a área comercial para entender as prioridades de atendimento e garantir que os assistentes de logística as cumpram de forma eficaz.
  5. Análise da Capacidade da Frota: Avaliar a adequação da disponibilização de cotas de veículos em relação à capacidade real da frota, identificando oportunidades de otimização.
  6. Acompanhamento da Programação no Sistema do Cliente: Garantir a inserção precisa e oportuna da programação diária no sistema do cliente, assegurando a integridade dos dados e a visibilidade das operações.
  7. Identificação e Análise de Gargalos: Monitorar e analisar o processo de agendamento de carga e descarga no sistema do cliente, identificando gargalos e propondo soluções para otimizar o fluxo operacional.

description:
O cargo de Analista de PCP (Planejamento e Controle de Produção) envolve responsabilidades como: programação, controle e apontamento de produção, tanto nos processos internos quanto externos, de acordo com os prazos de entrega e pedidos existentes na empresa. Suas principais atividades incluem:

  1. Efetua as atividades de programação, controle e apontamento de produção : Planeja as atividades de produção de acordo com as demandas e prazos estabelecidos. Controla o progresso da produção, garantindo que os processos estejam dentro dos parâmetros planejados. Registra e atualiza dados relacionados à produção no sistema para garantir o acompanhamento adequado.
  2. Acompanha processos internos e externos : Acompanha a produção tanto dentro da empresa quanto junto a fornecedores ou parceiros terceirizados. Assegura que os prazos e especificações sejam cumpridos em todas as etapas do processo de produção.
  3. Acompanha prazos de entrega e pedidos existentes : Monitora os prazos de entrega dos produtos ou serviços. Verifica o status dos pedidos e garante que sejam atendidos conforme o acordado com os clientes.

  5. Direciona atividades para terceiros : Coordena as atividades de fornecedores ou empresas terceirizadas, assegurando que o trabalho seja realizado de acordo com os padrões e prazos estabelecidos.
  6. Indica prioridades de produção : Define e comunica as prioridades dentro da produção, levando em consideração as necessidades urgentes e os prazos de entrega.
  7. Organiza as Ordens de Produção (OPs) no sistema ERP : Utiliza o sistema ERP para inserir, monitorar e gerenciar as Ordens de Produção (OPs), garantindo que todas as etapas sejam cumpridas conforme o planejamento e controle de produção.

  9. Programa entregas e instalações : Planeja as entregas de produtos, gerenciando as datas e a logística envolvida. Planeja e coordena a instalação e execução das obras, garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos e qualidade do serviço.

Com seu crescimento institucional, a SPDM expande suas áreas de atuação com projetos em desenvolvimento na assistência social e na educação. Essas atividades consolidam a SPDM como uma grande instituição filantrópica que busca sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

  9. Seguir as determinações do gestor imediato e as padronizações da instituição.

Promover ações em saúde integradas à gestão pública, beneficiando a população de forma ética, humanizada, com qualidade técnica e compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão:

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, garantindo atendimento de qualidade a todos os níveis de assistência na população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

A cultura do isaac incentiva a autonomia, a mão na massa, o trabalho em equipe e o uso de dados para construir soluções inovadoras.

Vem com a gente?

A Activesoft é referência nacional em soluções de gestão e tecnologia para escolas, oferecendo um ERP completo que potencializa a eficiência operacional e financeira das instituições de ensino. Há mais de duas décadas, transformamos a educação por meio da inovação e da automação de processos essenciais no dia a dia escolar.

Desde 2021, fazemos parte da Arco Educação , maior grupo de educação básica do Brasil. Atualmente, a Activesoft passa por um momento estratégico de transformação e integração , se consolidando como o ERP oficial da Arco e assumindo papel central no ecossistema educacional do grupo.

Atendemos escolas de todo o Brasil com um portfólio robusto e um compromisso inabalável com o sucesso dos nossos parceiros. Aqui, valorizamos a autonomia, a colaboração, decisões orientadas por dados e a paixão por resolver problemas reais da educação.

  • Atuar diretamente com mantenedores, diretores e decisores estratégicos, conduzindo relacionamentos consultivos de alto impacto.
  • Monitorar e agir com base em indicadores-chave (churn, NPS, HealthScore, usabilidade, CSAT), com visão preditiva e capacidade analítica.
  • Orquestrar iniciativas em conjunto com Produto, Vendas, Implantação e demais áreas para aprimorar a experiência dos clientes e a maturidade da operação.
  • Representar institucionalmente a Activesoft em eventos, fóruns executivos e iniciativas de relacionamento com o mercado.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de times de CS ou KAM em ambientes B2B, com foco em contas estratégicas ou enterprise.
  • Histórico de atuação consultiva com grandes clientes, envolvendo negociação, engajamento e expansão de contas.

O Engenheiro de Dados Júnior será responsável por desenvolver, manter e otimizar pipelines de dados, garantindo a confiabilidade e a eficiência dos dados para diversas áreas da empresa. Suas atividades incluirão a extração, transformação e carga (ETL) de dados, a criação e manutenção de APIs de dados, além de apoiar no monitoramento e na melhoria da infraestrutura de dados para facilitar análises e processos de machine learning. Será um facilitador para que os dados estejam acessíveis e prontos para uso, promovendo a democratização dos dados e o desenvolvimento de soluções data driven.


Main responsibilities

Entre as suas atividades, estão:

  • Pensamento analítico e habilidades de resolução de problemas: capacidade de entender fluxos de dados complexos e de identificar e resolver problemas que possam comprometer a qualidade ou o acesso aos dados.
  • Forte noções de modelagem e arquitetura de dados: compreensão de esquemas de banco de dados, armazenamento em data warehouses, organização e limpeza de dados.
  • Conceitos de ETL e integração de dados: habilidade para transformar dados brutos em dados utilizáveis e integrálos de maneira confiável nas fontes de dados internas e externas.
  • Orientação a boas práticas de programação e qualidade de código: conhecimento de padrões e princípios que favoreçam a escalabilidade, a manutenção e a legibilidade dos pipelines de dados.
  • Colaboração e comunicação: habilidades para trabalhar de forma colaborativa com cientistas de dados, analistas e outros stakeholders para entender suas necessidades e adaptar as soluções de dados.

Requirements and skills

  • Conhecimento de linguagens de programação aplicadas a dados, especialmente Python.
  • Conhecimento básico em SQL para consultas e manipulação de dados.
  • Noções de versionamento de código, preferencialmente usando Git.
  • Experiência com Airflow para orquestração de pipelines.
  • Familiaridade com Google Cloud Platform (GCP) ou outro provedor de nuvem.
  • Noções de Criação de APIs para disponibilização de dados.
  • Conhecimentos em Docker para ambientes de desenvolvimento e execução de containers.

As vagas são para moradores de Botucatu e São Manuel (SP), sendo 30% reservadas para grupos sociais sub-representados, como uma iniciativa para promover a inclusão na indústria, especialmente para mais mulheres e pessoas pretas e pardas.

O objetivo do curso é desenvolver competências técnicas, preparando os participantes para futuras oportunidades no mercado aeronáutico. Com foco em Mecânica, a capacitação será realizada no SENAI Luiz Massa, em Botucatu, com início em 7 de outubro e término em 18 de dezembro. Serão oferecidas duas turmas à tarde, das 13h às 17h.

Para participar, os interessados devem ter 18 anos ou mais, Ensino Médio completo e passar por uma prova presencial com questões de raciocínio lógico e melhoria contínua. As 160 primeiras inscrições que atenderem aos critérios de elegibilidade serão selecionadas. Um dos requisitos é não ter trabalhado na Embraer anteriormente, pois o curso aborda conceitos básicos já conhecidos por ex-empregados da empresa.

A formação é financiada pela Embraer e totalmente gratuita. As inscrições devem ser feitas pelo link: . As próximas etapas incluem a prova presencial, agendada para 28 de setembro, e a divulgação dos aprovados em dois dias. Custos de transporte e alimentação durante a capacitação serão de responsabilidade dos participantes aprovados.

A Embraer é uma empresa aeroespacial global com sede no Brasil, fabricante de aeronaves para aviação comercial, executiva, defesa, segurança e agricultura. A empresa também oferece serviços e suporte pós-venda por meio de uma rede mundial de unidades próprias e agentes autorizados.

Desde sua fundação em 1969, a Embraer já entregou mais de 9.000 aeronaves. A cada 10 segundos, um avião fabricado pela Embraer decola em algum lugar do mundo, transportando mais de 150 milhões de passageiros por ano.

A Embraer lidera a fabricação de jatos comerciais de até 150 assentos e é a principal exportadora de bens de alto valor agregado do Brasil. Possui unidades industriais, escritórios, centros de serviços e distribuição de peças nas Américas, África, Ásia e Europa.

Join Medpace at our Sao Paulo office! Our clinical operations activities are growing rapidly, and we are currently seeking a full-time, Site Contract Manager to join our LatAm Site Contracts team within the Clinical Operations department. This position will report to the LatAm Senior Contract Manager and will play a key role in the study start-up and clinical trial management processes at Medpace. The Contract Manager will play a key role in advancing the start-up of our projects. If you want an exciting career where you use your previous expertise and can develop and grow your career even further, then this is the opportunity for you.
Responsibilities

  • Act as Contract Study Lead on allocated studies with active responsibility for the performance of the contract team assigned to the study, acting as a primary point of contact between Sponsor and study teams, determining site contract processes, delegating duties to staff, and providing functional oversight of site contract and budget negotiations;
  • Create project-specific site contract documents, including study templates;
  • Review contract queries that fall outside of agreed parameters escalated by Contract Specialists;
  • Ensure Contract staff provide timely and accurate budget and contract review and execution, as well as meaningful updates in ClinTrak;
  • Facilitate clear communication, evaluation, and reporting of ongoing contract negotiations to study teams (e.g., Clinical Trial Management, Regulatory Submissions), ensuring that timelines are met, delays are managed effectively, and study team and Sponsor concerns are addressed as appropriate;
  • Provide contract support and advice related to site payments, site contracts, and other related documents and vendor contracts, identifying potential contractual issues, addressing, escalating and/or resolving such in order to minimize contractual risk to the organization;
  • Support in the development and implementation of contract management and compliance initiatives;
  • Line manage local or remote staff where applicable, including recruitment, training and development, and functional oversight of staff; and
  • May be responsible for other projects and responsibilities as assigned.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree, preferably in the area of Business, Life Sciences, or Law, with 4 years of clinical research industry experience, in clinical operations with contract management experience, or Juris Doctorate/Advanced education in the field of law and 2 years of clinical research industry experience with contract management experience;
  • Experience with LATAM Site Contracts required; US project experience preferred;
  • Broad knowledge of clinical trial conduct, standards of Good Clinical Practice, and applicable regulations and laws;
  • Demonstrated knowledge and ability to review and revise contracts for legal implications; and
  • Demonstrated ability to successfully motivate and collaborate with internal and external study team members, including Contract Specialists without direct reporting relationship.
  • Fluency in English
  • We kindly ask to submit CV in English
Medpace Overview
Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO). We provide Phase I-IV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through its scientific and disciplined approach. We leverage local regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic disease, endocrinology, central nervous system, anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, employing more than 5,000 people across 40+ countries.
Why Medpace?
When you join Medpace, you become part of a team dedicated to supporting the development of ground-breaking drugs and devices. Our employees provide hope for those living with debilitating diseases. We invite you to be a part of something that is impacting millions of people around the globe while enjoying a competitive total compensation and benefits package and internal growth opportunities.
Organic Growth: Medpace is continuing to grow in all areas globally and has built an expansive research campus at its headquarters in Cincinnati, OH. In 2020, Medpace opened a new seven story building that is approximately 250,000 SQFT. In total, the headquarter's campus includes five buildings and approximately 600,000 SQFT. The company also has expanding office locations in Dallas, TX and Denver, CO.

The Proximity Specialist is responsible for capturing affiliate needs by conducting interviews and analyzing feedback to ensure product alignment with local requirements. Job Description
Your mission at Jus Mundi
Brazil is a growing market for our services. Our portfolio of clients includes the most renowned law firms in Brazil, such as Mattos Filho, BM&A, FCDG, Tozzini Freire, Sergio Bermudes, Lefosse, alongside boutique law firms specializing in arbitration, expert firms, and leading companies. We are proud to partner with the most prominent arbitral institutions in the region, including the ICC, CAM-CCBC, CBMA, CAMARB, AMCHAM, and more than 100 institutions globally.
As a Brazil Account Executive, you will be responsible for prospecting the Brazilian market and driving new business for the company.
You Will Be In Charge Of

  • Prospection, development and follow-up of your prospects and clients’ portfolio via phone, mail, social network and face-to-face meetings.
  • Managing inbound leads, generating outbound leads, and handling them all through the sales process, until the closing.
  • Demonstrating the value of Jus Mundi to prospects, remotely or face-to face, and with a large public.
  • Managing and tracking customer information, activities, pipeline metrics and accurate forecasts in CRM.
  • Negotiating with legal executives.
  • Helping elaborate the sales strategy in terms of acquisition and retention, under the supervision of the Director of Brazil.
  • Learning to master our AI tools to showcase their full potential and help clients streamline their workflows.
Preferred Experience
️ Preferred Experience and Skills
  • A legal professional experience (law degree required), ideally with 3–4 years’ experience in a law firm, arbitration institution, or related environment.
  • You’re looking to transition into a sales/commercial role and excited about business development in the legal tech space - We’ll train you: You don’t need prior sales experience — we’ll provide full onboarding and mentoring to help you grow into the role.
  • You’re familiar with or eager to learn about B2B sales processes and tools (CRMs, Sales Navigator, etc.).
  • You’re a native Portuguese speaker, with strong professional English (Spanish is a bonus).
  • You’re comfortable engaging with senior legal stakeholders and speaking in public.
  • You’re organized, autonomous, and proactive — you bring structure and energy to your work.
  • You’re passionate about legal innovation, AI, and the future of law.
Recruitment process
Interview process
We’re proud of our multicultural team representing 35+ nationalities! To ensure smooth communication, please apply in English.
  • Screening Call with our Talent Acquisition Manager (30 min)
  • Hiring Manager Interview with our Director of Brazil (1 h)
  • Business Case Interview with our Senior VP Global Sales and our Director of Global Markets (1 h)
  • Team fit Meeting with the Latam/Brazil Team (30 min)
  • Last interview with our CEO and/or our VP of People (30 min)
Ideally, you will meet our Director of Brazil in person in São Paulo, in August or September 2025.
Please note that, due to the nature of the sector we operate in, the final steps of our recruitment process include reference calls and a background check.
Need More Reasons to Join Us?
  • Participate in company-wide summits called JM Fest to connect and inspire.
  • ️Stay active with a co-financed ClassPass membership by accessing a variety of fitness and wellness activities.
  • Enjoy the flexibility to work from anywhere across the globe for up to 8 weeks per year.
  • Profit from our support in ongoing training to continually expand your skills and knowledge.
  • Last but not least: Experience a commitment to building a warm, inclusive, and diverse environment.
Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we’ll let you in on a secret: there’s no such thing as a ‘perfect’ candidate. So however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come to work every day.
 Who are they?
Join Jus Mundi – To Power Global Justice ️
Founded in 2019 and recognized as a mission-led company, Jus Mundi is pioneering legal technology to power global justice through artificial intelligence. Headquartered in Paris, with additional offices in New York, London, and Singapore, Jus Mundi serves over 150,000 users, including top law firms, multinational corporations, government bodies, and academic institutions in more than 80 countries. By combining legal expertise with cutting-edge AI technology, we provide global legal intelligence, data-driven arbitration professional selection, and business development services.
What Makes Jus Mundi the Place to Be
  • Our Values: With core values as Friendly, Committed, Explorative, and Excelsior, we cultivate a dynamic environment that encourages collaboration, innovation, and continuous growth.
  • Proven Product Market Fit: Jus Mundi has secured product-market fit in global markets since launch, partnering with top-tier law firms, government bodies, and major corporations, including: Freshfields, Quinn Emanuel, Wong Partnership, Total Energies, Canada, UK, and Japan.
  • Strategic Investment: We recently raised over $20 million in Series B funding from prominent strategic international investors, including Acton Capital, True Global Ventures, C4 Ventures, and FJ Labs, fueling our growth and innovation.
  • Legal Meets Tech: Our engineers and former lawyers collaborate closely with large language models (LLMs) to pioneer the future of generative AI and reshape professional services.
  • Exceptional Team: Work with talented professionals from industry leaders, including engineers, legal experts, and AI specialists from companies like Google and Amazon who are pushing the boundaries of legal tech.
About the Role
Jus Mundi is looking for an Account Executive - Brazil, based in São Paulo , to grow our footprint in the Brazilian legal market.
You’ll work closely with our Brazil Country Director and play a key role in driving new business, engaging top-tier law firms, and supporting our expansion strategy in the region.
This is a remote role based in São Paulo, with occasional travel for client meetings and industry events.
The Team
We’re an international team of 15+ sales professionals working across Latin America, Europe, and Asia, all driven by a shared goal: to empower global justice through innovation, and transforming the legal industry with cutting-edge AI solutions.
We work with top-tier law firms, corporates, governments and universities in over 80 countries, from Chile to Japan and from Norway to South Africa. The Latam Sales team is currently composed of 4 people and you will be working directly with the Brazil Country Director, based in Paris.

title: AI Developer Course
description:
ללמוד לכתוב קוד בעזרת AI: להפוך את הקידוד לפשוט ונגיש לכולם

בעולם הטכנולוגיה של היום, כתיבת קוד אינה נחלתם של מתכנתים בלבד. בעזרת כלים מבוססי AI, ניתן להפוך את תהליך התכנות לנגיש, קל ומהיר – גם עבור מי שאין לו ניסיון קודם בתכנות. מטרת התוכנית שלנו היא ללמד אנשים ללא רקע בתכנות איך להגיע לרמה מקצועית של כתיבת קוד, תוך שימוש בכלי AI מתקדמים שמפשטים את התהליך ומאפשרים להגיע לתוצרים מרשימים ואיכותיים.

התוכנית מעניקה למשתתפים את הידע והכלים הנדרשים כדי ליצור פתרונות טכנולוגיים מתקדמים ולפתח קוד ברמה גבוהה, מבלי להידרש למיומנויות תכנות מסורתיות. עם שילוב של לימוד תאורטי ותרגול מעשי, המשתתפים יגלו כיצד לשלב יצירתיות וטכנולוגיה על מנת לפתור בעיות מורכבות בצורה פשוטה ואפקטיבית.

מה התוכנית שלנו מציעה?

במהלך התוכנית, המשתתפים יכירו את יסודות הבינה המלאכותית (AI) וכיצד היא משנה את האופן שבו אנו כותבים קוד. הם ילמדו להשתמש בכלי AI מובילים כמו Copilot GitHub, AI Cursor ו-Google Colab – אשר הופכים את תהליך כתיבת הקוד לפשוט ואינטואיטיבי. התוכנית כוללת גם הכרות עם AI Generative, שמאפשר ליצור קוד בהתאמה אישית בצורה קלה ומהירה.

נושא מרכזי בתוכנית הוא לימוד שפת Python. המשתתפים ילמדו את היסודות לתכנות, כולל עבודה עם משתנים, פונקציות, לולאות ומבני נתונים, תוך שימוש ב-AI לשיפור הקוד והאצת התהליך. בנוסף, יילמדו טכניקות מתקדמות של Engineering Prompt – כיצד לנסח פרומפטים בצורה אפקטיבית, כדי להפיק את המרב מכלי AI וליצור פתרונות מותאמים אישית.

התוכנית גם מתמקדת בכתיבת קוד מתקדם ואוטומציה, כולל פיתוח צ’אטבוטים, בניית אפליקציות אינטראקטיביות, ושילוב AI עם כלים כמו LangChain ו-Flask. המשתתפים ילמדו לעבוד עם SQL לניתוח נתונים, כולל שילוב Python לכתיבת שאילתות מתקדמות וניתוח מאגרי נתונים אמיתיים.

חלק נוסף בתוכנית יעסוק בעיבוד תמונה (Computer Vision) עם כלים מתקדמים כמו YOLOv ו-Anything Segment המאפשרים לזהות ולנתח תמונות בצורה אוטומטית. המשתתפים יוכלו לפתח אפליקציות מבוססות AI לעיבוד תמונה ווידאו, ולחקור יישומים מתקדמים של זיהוי תמונות ואובייקטים.

בנוסף, המשתתפים יעבדו על פרויקטים מעשיים המשלבים את כל מה שנלמד בקורס, ויסיימו עם פרויקט גמר מקיף שיאפשר להם להציג את יכולותיהם בתחום. התוכנית מכינה את המשתתפים לעבודה מקצועית, תוך שילוב טכנולוגיה, יצירתיות וכלים מתקדמים לפתרון בעיות בצורה אפקטיבית.

בוגרי הקורס שלנו יוכלו להשתלב בתפקידים כמו:

  • מומחה לפרומפטים (Prompt Engineer) – יצירת והכוונת פרומפטים למודלים של AI כמו ChatGPT או מודלים חזותיים ליצירת תוכן מדויק ופתרון בעיות.
  • מומחה לבינה מלאכותית יישומית (AI Application Specialist) – שימוש בכלי AI כמו AI Cursor ו-Copilot GitHub לייעול תהליכים בארגונים.
  • מפתח כלים מבוססי AI (AI Tools Developer) – פיתוח ושילוב כלים מבוססי AI בתוך תהליכים ארגוניים קיימים לשיפור היעילות.
  • מתכנת Python – יכולת לכתוב ולנהל קוד Python בסיסי עם שילוב כלי AI לפרויקטים פשוטים.
  • מפתח אפליקציות ללא קוד (No-Code Developer) – עבודה על פיתוח אפליקציות תוך שימוש בפלטפורמות כמו LangChain ו-Flask.
  • מומחה אוטומציה (Automation Specialist) – ייעול תהליכים באמצעות אוטומציה ב-Google Sheets, שליחת הודעות דוא”ל ו-SMS.

A CPA MÁQUINAS, representante da marca New Holland, integra a GF MÁQUINAS, que é a divisão de máquinas e implementos agrícolas do Grupo Ferrarin.

Tudo começou em 1969 na cidade de Palmeira da Missões/RS, numa pequena loja de fumo, de palmo e corda em metro, quando o Sr. Wilson Ferrarin acompanhado de sua esposa, Dona Santina, inicia uma jornada de muito trabalho e sucesso. Em 1977, com o objetivo de apoiar o desenvolvimento da região foi fundada a Agrofel Grãos e Insumos e ao longo dos anos, fomos evoluindo e crescendo, até nos tornarmos concessionária New Holland em 1994. Em 2010, com a fusão da Agrofel Grãos e Insumos com a Inducalca ocorreu a cisão da operação de máquinas e nos tornamos Agrofel Máquinas. Porém em 2019, a Bunge adquiriu 30% da Agrofel Grãos e Insumos, com isso, em 2020 a Agrofel Máquinas passou a se chamar CPA MÁQUINAS, uma empresa ainda mais determinada a impulsionar o sucesso do agronegócio gaúcho.

Atualmente estamos em 11 lojas e com elas atendemos 130 municípios, sempre trabalhando com tradição e qualidade para fornecer o que há de melhor em plantio e colheita. Aqui na CPA MÁQUINAS, o que nos move é o nosso propósito de fazer o melhor por quem produz alimentos.

Nós, CPA MÁQUINAS e New Holland, estamos comprometidos em oferecer aos nossos clientes o que há de mais moderno e avançado em tecnologia agrícola, segurança e conforto, garantindo a melhor performance em suas lavouras.

title: QA/QC Engineer
description:
